description: Search the ads LinkedIn shows in its public Ad Library, by advertiser, by words in the ad or by company id, optionally by country and date: each ad's advertiser, format, headline, text, image or video, call to action, where it leads, when it ran, its impressions range and its targeting, about 25 a page. Use this to watch what a competitor advertises. Give exactly one of `advertiser` or `company_id` or `query`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

advertiser.description: The advertiser's name, as the library searches it. It matches loosely: a person whose name contains it can appear.

company_id.description: LinkedIn's numeric id for the company, `company_id` in linkedin/company: that company's ads only.

countries.description: Only ads shown in these countries: two-letter codes, comma-separated, e.g. `US,GB`.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

end_date.description: Only ads shown on or before this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, before today. With `start_date`.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

start_date.description: Only ads shown on or after this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, within the last year. With `end_date`.

name: search_linkedin_ads
title: Search LinkedIn's Ad Library
